guidance.docs.create:
# Confluence

- Confirm cloudId, space and parent content identity through the connected Rovo MCP schema.
- Create page content only in the requested location; retain the wholeloop ID and returned link.
- Every update uses the core read-modify-write helper: getConfluenceContent first in the same operation.
- Preserve unrelated sections and macros; transform the fetched representation, not a guessed blank page.
- Carry the fetched version into the update where the live schema supports optimistic concurrency.
- A version conflict requires another read and review; never retry a blind overwrite.
- Normalize a complete read to ref/body/revision; truncated or permission-redacted reads block writes.
- Record the returned page URL only after a successful synchronous result.
- Reference: [Official documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/rovo-mcp/guides/supported-tools/)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live page-format conformance remains pending.

manifest.name: GitHub Issues
manifest.description: Publish wholeloop definitions through GitHub Issues.

guidance.tracker.create-item:
# GitHub Issues

- Use the official GitHub MCP issues toolset; confirm the connected account/repository.
- Require explicit owner and repo. For updates include issue_number; do not infer it from a title.
- issue_write uses method create or update; issue_read uses method get.
- Keep the wholeloop ID in the body and adopt its existing link before creating another issue.
- Preserve labels, assignees and unrelated text on update. Transition only to the requested issue state.
- Record the returned html_url as the tracker link. A tool error is not publication.
- OAuth and permissions belong to the host client; do not copy credentials.
- Unsupported relationship operations remain explicit local links, not guessed MCP calls.
- Reference: [Official documentation](https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live account conformance remains pending.

manifest.name: GitLab Issues
manifest.description: Publish wholeloop definitions through GitLab Issues.

guidance.tracker.create-item:
# GitLab Issues

- Use the official GitLab MCP endpoint; override its host for self-managed instances.
- Confirm the namespace and supported version; save_work_item/get_work_item replace legacy issue tools.
- Creation needs an explicit project_id (or group_id/URL), title and type_name Issue.
- Updates need the existing work item URL or work_item_iid; omit fields that are not changing.
- Resolve actual relationship types with the connected tool schema before link_work_items.
- Do not create labels or choose milestones implicitly. Keep the wholeloop ID in the description.
- Record the returned web_url; preserve a local artifact if tools or permissions are unavailable.
- OAuth is managed by the client. No credential values belong in manifests or arguments.
- Reference: [Official documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/model_context_protocol/mcp_server_tools/)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live version/account conformance remains pending.

manifest.name: Google Docs
manifest.description: Publish wholeloop definitions through Google Docs.

guidance.docs.create:
# Google Docs

- Use the optional Google Workspace CLI gws and its own encrypted credential store.
- The core declares operations; the host invokes gws with argv, --params JSON and --json request JSON.
- Create returns an empty document ID; insert content using read-modify-write before reporting publication.
- Get the full document (including tabs) and revisionId before every batchUpdate operation.
- Preserve structural elements and unrelated tabs; do not flatten a rich document into guessed plain text.
- Transform the fetched document into batch requests and carry writeControl.requiredRevisionId.
- A stale revision fails; re-read and review before retrying. Never suppress writeControl on conflict.
- Normalize the complete document JSON to ref/body/revision; body is the fetched JSON representation.
- Use the returned documentId to record `https://docs.google.com/document/d/<id>/edit`.
- Native Docs MCP currently exposes read/update only, so creation uses the optional CLI.
- References: [Official documentation](https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli)
- [API reference](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/batchUpdate)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. No CLI was installed; live auth/conformance remains pending.

guidance.tracker.create-item:
# Jira

- Use the Atlassian Rovo MCP Jira tools and confirm cloudId/project before writes.
- Discover required issue fields and allowed transitions in the current site's tool schema.
- Carry the wholeloop ID and existing tracker key; an edit uses the existing key, never a new issue.
- Preserve unrelated description sections and field values; use the site's supported rich-text format.
- Resolve actual issue/transition/link type IDs rather than deriving them from names.
- Record the returned issue URL. Missing create/edit permission becomes a local handoff.
- OAuth belongs to the host. Never persist an API token in a manifest or fixture.
- Reference: [Official documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/rovo-mcp/guides/supported-tools/)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live site conformance remains pending.

guidance.tracker.create-item:
# Linear

- Use the official read-write Linear MCP endpoint and confirm the authenticated workspace/team.
- save_issue creates without an id and updates with the existing id; do not use retired create_issue aliases.
- Supply the real team identifier for creation and preserve the wholeloop ID in the description.
- Fetch the existing issue before editing. Preserve unrelated description and metadata.
- Resolve workflow states in the actual team before setting state; do not guess a status ID.
- Record the returned issue URL. Permissions or unavailable tools leave publication pending.
- Unsupported relationship mappings remain local; do not invent a tool name.
- References: [Official documentation](https://linear.app/docs/mcp) and [Official documentation](https://linear.app/integrations/slack)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live account conformance remains pending.

guidance.docs.create:
# Notion

- Confirm the actual parent page/data source and writable properties from fetched schema.
- notion-create-pages creates content; use an existing page ID for notion-update-page.
- Every update first fetches the full page in the same read-modify-write operation.
- Preserve unrelated content and block references; prefer a targeted edit over replacing a whole page.
- Normalize complete fetched Markdown to ref/body/revision; truncation or hidden content blocks replacement.
- allow_async false requests a synchronous write. A returned async_task is still pending: poll it in the host.
- Record the page URL only on confirmed success. The core does not equate queued work with publication.
- Discover host aliases for fetch/search; OpenAI MCP clients can drop the notion- prefix.
- OAuth stays in the client store; do not create a plaintext integration-token config.
- Reference: [Official documentation](https://developers.notion.com/guides/mcp/mcp-supported-tools)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live host/schema conformance remains pending.

manifest.name: Repository docs
manifest.description: Publish wholeloop definitions through Repository docs.

guidance.docs.create:
# Repository docs

- This is intentional publication of documentation, never a runtime-state store.
- Resolve the requested Markdown path under the repository docs/ directory and reject symlink escapes.
- Ask for an explicit destination if none is known. Do not invent a tracked path.
- The host maps native.read-file/write-file to its own file tools; the core never runs arbitrary shell text.
- Create exclusively, without overwriting existing content. Update only through read-modify-write.
- Preserve front matter, navigation and unrelated sections; follow repository docs conventions.
- Normalize a full UTF-8 read to ref/body/revision (content digest for local concurrency checks).
- Verify the expected digest before atomic replacement. A conflict requires a fresh read/review.
- Report the relative path and optional code-host URL; do not commit or push as a side effect.
- Native tool availability, path containment and concurrent-write behavior need host conformance.
